pin.title: MEININGER Hotel Frankfurt Airport Opens
pin.description: A budget hotel and hostel hybrid at Frankfurt Airport’s Gateway Gardens, with private family rooms, a children’s corner and shared lounge spaces.
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Frankfurt’s municipal history institute chronology explicitly places the airport MEININGER opening under 5 January 2012. Götz A. Primke’s invited opening-visit report published that day independently says the hotel opens today. This is the airport property, not the separate former Messe hotel.
pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid at Frankfurt Airport’s Gateway Gardens, with private family rooms, a children’s corner and shared lounge spaces.

Family and budget stopover

Choose a whole private family room and confirm its beds, booked occupancy and cot requirements. Shared dormitory beds are a different product. The children’s corner and lounge provide shared space; compare the full room bill, breakfast, taxes, parking, storage and cancellation terms.

This property has no guest kitchen, according to the operator’s current help page. Plan meal costs separately rather than assuming self-catering facilities.

Plan the transfer to your actual airline terminal with children and luggage. The hotel is near Gateway Gardens station; check current tickets, routes and operating hours.

Terminal 2 closed to passenger operations on 9 June 2026, with its airlines relocated to Terminal 3. Older descriptions of a short walk to Terminal 2 should not be treated as a transfer plan for a current flight.

Guest feedback

Guests describe simple, clean rooms and useful airport access. Several 2026 accounts report hot or stuffy rooms and cooling that did not provide relief, including a family with a baby. Other tradeoffs include small rooms and noise with open windows. Confirm the actual room’s cooling arrangements and recent feedback, particularly for summer travel. Scores are a dated guest snapshot.

Opening and inventory

The hotel opened on 5 January 2012, as recorded by Frankfurt’s municipal history institute. This dates the airport hotel rather than the separate former Messe property.

The current operator portfolio lists 168 rooms and 414 beds. Older presentations listing 167 rooms and 412 beds are not substituted for the current portfolio. No property-specific construction investment was verified.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-23: refreshed Tripadvisor UK snapshot 1,165 reviews, overall 3.7/5. Rooms 3.7, Service 3.8, Location 4.2, Cleanliness 4.3, Value 4.0 rounded to half steps. gethicla76 firsthand couple review June 2026, site-translated from French; exact day unknown. Strong 2026 heat/cooling concerns retained. MICHELIN Frankfurt complete 1–15 of 15 no match; Forbes Frankfurt unavailable, AAA excludes Germany. Acclaim null.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort in Bloomington near the Mall of America, with suites, indoor water-park admission included with overnight stays and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Confirm the exact suite layout, beds and booked guests. Overnight stays include water-park admission; check operating hours, wristbands, height restrictions and supervision. Dining, parking, arcade games and other paid attractions add to the bill. Compare the full package and arrival-day or departure-day admission terms.

The operator lists 404 suites and a 75,000-square-foot indoor water park, with a microwave in each suite and no fitness centre at this lodge. The resort is in Bloomington near the Mall of America, rather than in central Minneapolis or St. Paul.

Guest feedback

A September family account describes fun activities and helpful staff while criticizing changing space, places to hang wet swimwear and food value. A November guest reports a comfortable room and children enjoying the stay, alongside costly extras, disappointing food and noise from a water-park-facing balcony room. These are individual guest reports. Check recent feedback and the exact room location; scores are a dated snapshot.

Grand opening and renovation

The Great Wolf grand-opening celebration took place on 12 December 2017. A firsthand attendee documents the media celebration and the renovation of the former Water Park of America. This is the Great Wolf conversion event, rather than the original resort’s first opening.

Contemporary reporting put the conversion renovation at US$30 million, covering water-park, restaurant and room updates. The later opening-tour account repeats that renovation figure. It is separate from the property purchase price, original construction and nightly room rates; it is not an audited final-cost breakdown.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-23: refreshed Tripadvisor UK snapshot 1,687 reviews, overall 3.6/5. Rooms 3.9, Service 3.8, Location 4.4, Cleanliness 4.1, Value 3.2 rounded to half steps. Teresa E firsthand family review September 2026, exact day unknown. Changing space, wet-clothing storage, dining costs and November balcony-noise complaints retained. AAA exact 404-unit resort verified. MICHELIN Bloomington route is Indiana, rejected; Minnesota route and Forbes Minneapolis unavailable. Acclaim null.
